introduction.title: Keep a small summary instead of every observation
paragraphs: A sketch summarizes a large collection of values in a compact data structure. Apache DataSketches provides algorithms for questions such as how many distinct values appeared, which items are frequent, or where a percentile falls.

This extension lets you build sketches from DuckDB columns, store them, and merge them later. For example, daily sketches can produce a longer-period estimate without rereading all the original rows. Choose the sketch family and size according to the question and the approximation you can accept.
